choose.when: and o.status = 1 and (t.status = 0 or t.status is null)

mapper.insert: insert into group_buy_order( order_id, user_id, team_id, activity_id, product_id, product_name, quantity, source, channel, original_amount, deduction_amount, pay_amount, status, out_trade_no, create_time, update_time ) values( #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{teamId}, #{activityId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{quantity}, #{source}, #{channel}, #{originalAmount}, #{deductionAmount}, #{payAmount}, #{status}, #{outTradeNo}, now(), now() )
mapper.select: select id, order_id, user_id, team_id, activity_id, product_id, product_name, quantity, source, channel, original_amount, deduction_amount, pay_amount, status, out_trade_no, create_time, update_time from group_buy_order where user_id = #{userId} and activity_id = #{activityId} and status = 0 order by id desc limit 1
select user_id from group_buy_order where team_id = #{teamId}
select out_trade_no from group_buy_order where team_id = #{teamId} and status = 1

select o.out_trade_no from group_buy_order o left join group_buy_team t on o.team_id = t.team_id where (
(o.status = 0 and o.create_time < date_sub(now(), interval 15 minute)) or
(o.status = 1 and t.status = 0 and t.valid_end_time < now()) )
mapper.update: update group_buy_order set status = 2, update_time = now() where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} and status in (0, 1)
mapper.select: select count(o.id) from group_buy_order o left join group_buy_team t on o.team_id = t.team_id

select o.id, o.order_id, o.user_id, o.team_id, o.activity_id, o.product_id, o.product_name, o.quantity, o.source, o.channel, o.original_amount, o.deduction_amount, o.pay_amount, o.status, o.out_trade_no, t.valid_start_time, t.valid_end_time, t.status as team_status, o.create_time, o.update_time from group_buy_order o left join group_buy_team t on o.team_id = t.team_id
order by o.create_time desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
